points: Own core module development within a team-wide migration of the company's CRM/LMS platform from Angular 9 to React 18, building UI components across dashboards, forms, and workflow screens, including a canvas-style template editor.
Own end-to-end redesign, performance optimization, and maintenance of the chat application, including its Twilio-based communication component.

Fixed a chat performance issue causing the interface to lag under heavy message activity - identified the cause as unnecessary re-rendering on every incoming message, and reworked how the chat fetched and updated data to keep it responsive at scale.

Redesigned how chat integrates with the CRM - replacing a tightly-coupled embed that required manual wiring between the two systems with a self-contained, plug-and-play widget, removing that integration overhead for other teams.
Built and maintained Node.js/Express APIs and MongoDB/Mongoose schemas for authentication, access control, workflow records, and application data.
Set up monitoring for the SMS and chat servers to track application and server health - first hands-on step into infrastructure work.
Trained students in JavaScript and full-stack fundamentals (CRUD apps, auth flows, REST APIs) and took on freelance development for external B2B clients.
